subject: Security exhibit & audit kickoff — MSA/order form redlines and evidence cadence
content:
From: Alice Jones <alice.jones@healthcore.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: security@healthcore.com, procurement@healthcore.com
Date: Mon, 02 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: security exhibit + pen-test window

Hi Sean,

Thanks for the demo last week — HealthCore is excited about Redwood. Before we proceed to an order form, our security and procurement teams need: a completed security exhibit (SOC 2 point-in-time, and pen-test language), answers to the attached SOC2 questionnaire, and a proposed 2-week pen-test window for staging.

Can we schedule a kickoff to align on scope (what systems are in scope vs excluded), evidence cadence, and any order form / MSA redlines? We have a target procurement deadline of 2028-04-30.

Attachments: HealthCore-SOC2-Questions.xlsx (xlsx)

Thanks,
Alice Jones
Head of IT Security, HealthCore
security@healthcore.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@healthcore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security exhibit + pen-test window

Alice — thanks for the clear ask and the questionnaire. Happy to run a kickoff. Proposed slots: Wed 4/4 2pm PT or Thu 4/6 11am PT. The goal for the call: agree on audit scope (SOC 2 assertions), pen-test staging access & timeframe, and list of deliverables Redwoods will provide (SOC 2 report excerpt, SOC2 controls mapping, pen-test logistics, evidence list and cadence).

I'll bring legal (Laura) and our assurance lead (Monica). Karthik will review the pen-test/technical constraints.

Action: Please confirm a slot and we’ll send calendar invite + pre-reads.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 05 Apr 2028 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security exhibit + pen-test window

Team — I reviewed HealthCore's questionnaire and drafted an MSA/order-form security exhibit redline set. Key notes:

- Pen-test language: propose we accept customer-requested tests against staging with a 14-day notice and agreed IP/subnet list; require limited blast radius and no social-engineering; add indemnity carveout language for third-party tester engagements.
- Audit rights: recommend timeboxed inspection windows (2 business days for on-demand sampling, and up to 10 business days for deeper evidence requests) and a formal evidence request ticketing process to avoid overloading ops.
- SOC 2: we can provide latest SOC 2 Type II report and a controls mapping that ties HealthCore's questionnaire rows to our SOC 2 controls.
- Data retention & logging evidence: we will provide sample logs and retention policy doc; redact tenant-specific PII per our privacy policy.

I attached the redline bundle (MSA_redlines_v1.docx). If HealthCore insists on broader inspection rights or unfettered access, we push back and offer compensating controls (more granular logs, extended reporting cadence).

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MSA_redlines_v1.docx (docx)

-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: pen-test scope / evidence buckets (quick)

Quick notes for the kickoff:
- Scope: production is out-of-scope; staging environment with sanitized data is in scope. Provide ephemeral access via jumpbox + time-limited credentials.
- Evidence buckets: SOC2 report excerpt, control mapping (xlsx), sample logs (7 days), configuration snapshots, patching attestations, and the pen-test results summary.
- Ops constraints: avoid synchronous manual pulls during business hours; prefer asynchronous evidence delivery via secure share (Drive link) and ticketed reminder cadence.

Monica — can you prep the control mapping and point us to existing sample reports we can share early?

Thanks,
Karthik
Sr. Security Engineer

-----
From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Alice Jones <alice.jones@healthcore.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, monica_patel@redwood.com, procurement@healthcore.com, security@healthcore.com
Date: Mon, 09 Apr 2028 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: security exhibit + pen-test window — kickoff summary & agreed cadence

Alice — great to connect today. Recap below and next steps so we have a single place to track items.

Kickoff recap (agreed)
- Scope: Staging only (production explicitly excluded). Staging will be seeded with synthetic/scrubbed data.
- Pen-test window: target 2028-05-13 to 2028-05-26 (2-week window). HealthCore to confirm their vendor and provide IP ranges by 2028-04-15. 14-day notice required.
- Audit rights & evidence cadence: Redwood will provide the following on a 2-week cadence during onboarding, then monthly for ongoing customers: SOC 2 Type II report excerpt (redacted), controls mapping (xlsx), sample logs (rolling 7 days), and a pen-test summary report after completion. For ad-hoc evidence requests beyond the agreed buckets we require a ticket and up to 10 business days for delivery.
- MSA/order form redlines: Laura provided MSA_redlines_v1.docx with recommended carveouts (timebound inspection windows, ticketing, indemnity language). Redwood is open to limited expansion of inspection windows for a fee/contract amendment.

Action items
1) HealthCore: confirm pen-test vendor and IP ranges by 2028-04-15 (Alice).
2) Redwood (Monica / Karthik): finalize control mapping and prepare sample artifacts by 2028-04-18.
3) Redwood (Laura): prepare a short rationale memo for the MSA carveouts (1 page) by 2028-04-16 and attach redline bundle.
4) Procurement (HealthCore): confirm whether they need additional commercial terms by 2028-04-20.

Attachments shared on call / next steps
- HealthCore-SOC2-Questions.xlsx (received)
- MSA_redlines_v1.docx (attached to legal email)
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/HC-2028-042
- DocuSign envelope placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPEID/abc123

If anything above is incorrect, flag it and I'll update. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround — aim to close procurement on schedule.

Best,
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Compliance Enablement
Redwood Inference
